headline: Keep {arm:September}. Both candidates regress on character adherence and raise reply costs.
lede: {arm:September} keeps character at {pass_rate.September|pct} for {scoreboard.September.reply_cost_usd|usd_per_1k}, outperforming both challengers on cost and adherence. A candidate would need to demonstrate higher adherence or significant savings without quality losses to justify a switch.

slots.text: Retain {arm:September} as the serving model. It achieves the highest adherence at {pass_rate.September|pct} and the lowest production spend at {scoreboard.September.reply_cost_usd|usd_per_1k}.

{arm:1017} drops adherence by {reading.1017.change|abs|pts} points while raising costs to {scoreboard.1017.reply_cost_usd|usd_per_1k}; {arm:qwen3.8-flash} drops adherence by {reading.qwen3.8-flash.change|abs|pts} points and increases reply cost to {scoreboard.qwen3.8-flash.reply_cost_usd|usd_per_1k}.

The weakest margin is {weakest.arm} with a drop of {weakest.value|abs|pts} points against {weakest.criterion} at {weakest.threshold|abs|pts} points (margin {weakest.margin|pts}). Two runs for {arm:qwen3.8-flash} dropped one harness cell each. Candidate reasoning ratios also varied substantially, confounding pure model architecture comparisons with differing reasoning allocations.
Test prompts specifically targeted at off-lane queries under matched reasoning token budgets if cost parity remains an objective.

caveats.material_if: The evaluated aspect was formally declared late, material only if different prompt evaluations were cherry-picked after testing.
The control designation occurred late, material only if baseline comparisons were biased post-hoc.
Judge calibration is undetermined, material only if systematic judge bias favors {arm:September} over candidates across character evaluations.

method.text: Evaluated {cases} cases across {repeats} repeats per arm in a one-factor-at-a-time design.
A trial passes character adherence if judge checks and tool execution constraints are fully met.
Contrasts are corrected using Holm's procedure at family level {family.level} across {family.family_size} comparisons.
Simulator request settings were not comprehensively logged, leaving an apparatus confound across runs.
Token usage figures and detailed LLM call tallies were omitted from reporting.
Judged evaluations use model {judge.model} under undetermined calibration tier.

explore.title: Explore adherence margin sensitivity
explore.recomputes: Altering the allowable drop margin does not alter the recommendation, as {arm:September} dominates on both adherence rate and reply cost.

durable_claims.text: {arm:September} delivers cheaper production replies at {scoreboard.September.reply_cost_usd|usd_per_1k} than {arm:qwen3.8-flash} at {scoreboard.qwen3.8-flash.reply_cost_usd|usd_per_1k}, contrary to prior expectations.

Both {arm:1017} and {arm:qwen3.8-flash} regress on character adherence relative to {arm:September}, with contrasts dropping by {contrast.1017.persona.holds_character.delta|abs|pts} and {contrast.qwen3.8-flash.persona.holds_character.delta|abs|pts} points respectively.
